title: Lorzy Event's International House Party Halloween (Oct 29)
sources: Shotgun event page: International House Party Halloween by Lorzy Event
igCaption: Miami's Halloween house party with a secret address 🎃 Tonight, Oct. 29, doors at 11pm. Tickets on Shotgun: International House Party Halloween by Lorzy Event.

scenes.text: Miami is hosting one of the craziest Halloween house parties ever. And the address is a secret.
It's Lorzy Event's International House Party Halloween. Tonight, October twenty-ninth. Doors open at eleven p.m.
scenes.caption: It's Lorzy Event's International House Party Halloween. Tonight, Oct. 29. Doors open at 11 p.m.

scenes.text: The address is a secret until you have a ticket. Here's the clue. It's twenty-five minutes from Miami Beach.
scenes.caption: The address is a secret until you have a ticket. Here's the clue: it's 25 min from Miami Beach.

scenes.text: Fifteen minutes from the airport. And nine minutes from FIU.
scenes.caption: 15 min from the airport. 9 min from FIU.

scenes.text: Inside, it's a full house made for dancing. Afro, Latino, hip-hop, R and B and commercial sets, with a crowd from all over the world. Drinks are five dollars.
scenes.caption: Inside, it's a full house made for dancing. Afro, Latino, hip-hop, R&B and commercial sets, with a crowd from all over the world. Drinks are $5.

scenes.text: Costumes are strongly encouraged. There's security on site. And ticket prices go up with every tier, so the earlier you buy, the less you pay. The exact address goes to ticket holders only.
scenes.caption: Costumes are strongly encouraged. There's security on site. Ticket prices go up with every tier, so the earlier you buy, the less you pay. The exact address goes to ticket holders only.

scenes.text: Who are you bringing? Tag them. And when you're there, open NEAR. See who else is at the party, and finally get the name of that person in the best costume before the night ends.
